```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
Lead_exposure_in_children <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(Lead_exposure_in_children))
```
This dataset explores the rates of lead exposure in children in the UK
```{r}
ggplot(Lead_exposure_in_children, aes(
  x = year,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks=6) +
xlab("year") +
  ylab("number of cases") +
  ggtitle("Rate of Lead Exposure in Children in the UK")
```
